fact: Bill no. 040/2026 on electronic communications and digital infrastructure, filed at the National Assembly on 28 August 2026, would require essential data of Madagascar-based organisations and firms (and administrative data of government) to be hosted on national territory, with a foreign copy allowed; it is not in force, as the deputies referred it to a later session on 5 September 2026.
title: Loi sur l'hébergement des données à Madagascar : qui est concerné et ce qui change
